latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "代驾服务" skill—an actionable guide for monetizing designated driver services.

- Provides a 90-day roadmap to achieve positive cash flow through driver-for-hire services.
- Details suitable user profiles, key revenue/cost models, core channels, and execution flow.
- Includes tool recommendations for production, marketing, tracking, and service fulfillment.
- Outlines compliance requirements and common pitfalls to avoid.
- Offers a step-by-step 30-day execution plan with weekly objectives and a practical checklist.
